faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.q1: How does the AI CV analysis work?
faq.a1: As soon as a CV is uploaded (PDF or DOCX), it is placed in a processing queue. Our AI (Mistral 7B, an open source model hosted locally) extracts the name, email, skills, years of experience, education and languages. The score is then calculated by comparing this data against the weighted criteria of your job listing. All of this in under 30 seconds.
faq.a2: Yes. All data is hosted in France on secure servers. CVs are stored with time-limited signed URLs (1 hour). Our AI runs locally — your CVs are never sent to a third-party service. We are GDPR compliant: each candidate can request access to or deletion of their data.
faq.q3: Can I import my existing candidates?
faq.a3: Yes. You can upload CVs in bulk directly from the interface. A CSV import file is also available for Pro and Enterprise plans, allowing you to migrate your data from another tool.
faq.q4: How long does it take to set up?
faq.a4: Less than 10 minutes. Create your account, configure your first job listing with weighted criteria, and share the application link. The AI handles the rest from the first CV received. No technical training required.
faq.q5: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
faq.a5: Yes, no commitment. You can cancel from your settings at any time. Your account automatically reverts to the Discovery plan. Your data is retained for 90 days after cancellation, then permanently deleted on request.
